info.name: OpenRegister API: revert, files, folders, notes, timeline, rules, migrations, API surface
info.description: Covers the HTTP surface of RevertController, FilesController, ObjectFolderController, TasksController, NotesController, TimelineEntriesController, TimelineAdminController, CalculationsController, RulesController, PropertyVocabularyController, SchemaMigrationController, ShippedBaselineController, SchemaImportController, OasController, ApiSurfaceController and ApiCallersController: per route the success path, an unknown id, invalid input, and the answer for a non-admin user without rights (an admin-only RBAC schema, or the admin-setting gate) followed by a re-read that shows nothing changed. Seeds its own data: `00 setup` creates a register, an open and an admin-only schema, three objects and a non-admin user (names suffixed per run), `99 teardown` deletes them. Needs no other collection and no external service; where a service is absent (Nextcloud Office, a task calendar) it asserts the clean refusal.
